answer: Liveness beacon with physical presence: each identity must return a signed challenge from a hardware module bound to a unique location at dawn local time. The kernel enforces that the module's clock and radio witness agree, so one operator cannot answer for two identities at once without shuttling hardware between sites. A single operator can fake keys but cannot fake being on a ledge in two cities at sunrise; each extra identity costs a second module plus a daily courier run, scaling linearly with fleet size.
